workstream: RENTipid GLOBAL-MKT / v2.0 — Global Marketplace Activation
objective: Full End-to-End Operation across ALL 46 Authoritative Jurisdictions
controllingRule: NO country is permanently listing-only or permanently excluded. All batches advance to full transaction operation.

batches.title: Batch 1: Domestic Core (Philippines)
batches.codeWork: Automated payout webhook listener and disbursement reconciliation

batches.title: Batch 2: Southeast Asia Regional Expansion
legalDependencies: Thai DBD registration, Singapore MAS exemption review, Malaysian MDEC review
batches.codeWork: Adapter for APAC multi-currency acquiring (THB, SGD, MYR, VND, IDR) & PromptPay/PayNow QR rails

batches.title: Batch 3: Anglo-American & Developed APAC
legalDependencies: US state sales tax nexus review, UK Consumer Rights Act, Australian Consumer Law
batches.codeWork: Multi-currency settlement engine for USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, KRW and automated 1099-K reporting hooks

batches.title: Batch 4: European Union / EEA Single Market
providerDependencies: Stripe Europe (SEPA Direct Debit / iDEAL / Bancontact / Klarna)

batches.title: Batch 5: Emerging Major Markets (LATAM, Middle East & South Asia)
providerDependencies: Local payment adapters (Brazil Pix, UAE Cards/Wallets, India UPI/Razorpay)

batches.title: Batch 6: Mainland China Special Regulatory Market
providerDependencies: WeChat Pay / Alipay Cross-Border / In-Country Gateway
legalDependencies: MIIT ICP commercial telecom license, CAC personal information localization compliance
batches.codeWork: Alipay/WeChat Pay QR scanner, CNY minor unit settlement, dedicated data isolation partition

CAC data transfer filing and server localization setup
